text:
Sam (People Ops): heads-up: Rina Kaur (start Mon) has a hyphenated last name on her passport but her driver’s license uses only one part. Background portal flagged an e-verify mismatch and I-9 needs plan. Can we triage? :mag:
Rina Kaur (new hire): Hi! Yes, my passport says Kaur-Singh but my CA DL was issued under Kaur. I uploaded both. Is a marriage cert needed?
Diego (Hiring Ops): Not necessarily. For I-9 we need docs that establish identity and employment authorization. USCIS requires matching names or a name-change document. Background/e-verify may accept supplemental docs. @Backgrounds what's the usual process?
Backgrounds (vendor): When name tokens differ we do manual review: we ask for one of these: marriage cert, court name change, or an affidavit plus a consistent secondary ID (SSN card, birth cert). If Rina can provide SSN card + statement, we can expedite.
Rina Kaur (new hire): I have an SSN card in the single-name format (Kaur) and a copy of my passport (Kaur-Singh). Uploading SSN now. Also can share a signed affidavit if needed.
Sam (People Ops): Good. Two follow-ups: 1) I-9 logistics (she's local to SF) 1 in-person kiosk 9:30am Mon reserved? 2) laptop shipping 1 IT prefers to ship overnight if we confirm address today.
IT-Logistics: We can overnight. Please confirm address and whether to require signature. Sample ship command we use: ```ship_label --to "Rina Kaur" --addr "475 Valencia St Apt 2, San Francisco, CA 94103" --service UPS-NextDay --signature required```
Rina Kaur (new hire): Office kiosk would be fine. I can also pick up the laptop from the SF office after the kiosk. Address above is my home if courier needed. Signature required please.
OnboardTracker: NOTE set by Sam: i9_status=scheduled_kiosk; bg_check=status_pending_manual_review; laptop=hold_for_office_pickup.
Backgrounds (vendor): Received SSN card scan. Manual review started. ETA 3 hours. If affidavit uploaded, please tag it with your portal ID so it links to the file.
Sam (People Ops): Payroll heads-up: if SSN card name differs we may need to mark payroll as "SSN pending" until final reconciliation. @Payroll can you comment?
Payroll: You can provisionally enroll employee for benefits but tax withholding needs SSN for payroll setup. Set W-4 with "SSN pending" flag and update once reconciliation is complete. We'll create a temporary tax placeholder.
Diego (Hiring Ops): Security note: VPN/admin disabled until I-9 + background soft-clear. We can enable limited dev sandbox access for Day-1. Jonah (IT) will you hold admin?
IT-Logistics: Holding admin. We'll provide guest WiFi instructions and a limited access dev workspace. IT will image laptop with standard profile and withhold admin until People Ops flips "i9_cleared".
Rina Kaur (new hire): Uploaded signed affidavit and a utility bill matching my current address. Thanks.
Backgrounds (vendor): Manual check complete: identity verified via passport + SSN card + affidavit. Marking background = soft-cleared; e-verify will re-run after HR confirms name reconciliation.
Sam (People Ops): Great. Action items: Sam to bring I-9 packet to kiosk; BadgeBot to create a 4-hour pickup pass for Rina; IT to stage laptop for office pickup; Payroll to provision provisional enrollment.
BadgeBot: Pickup pass created for rina.kaur@redwood.com 1 valid 96 hours from now 1 QR emailed. :white_check_mark:
Payroll: Provisional benefits enrollment set; tax setup pending SSN reconciliation.
OnboardTracker: UPDATE set by Sam: bg_check=soft_cleared; i9_status=completed_kiosk (scans uploaded); access=limited_dev_enabled.
Rina Kaur (new hire): Kiosk went well, Section 2 signed. Picked up laptop from office and booted it OK. Thanks all! :tada:
Sam (People Ops): Closing loop: Backgrounds will submit e-verify with reconciled name; Payroll to confirm SSN mapping tomorrow AM, IT to enable VPN/admin after People Ops sets final flag. Welcome aboard Rina!
